# Score24

> > Score24 delivers real-time sports data, livescore feeds, fixtures, and statistics APIs to clients worldwide since 1996.

Score24 is a sports data provider specializing in XML and JSON API feeds for live scores, match statistics, and sports fixtures. Founded in 1996, the company serves clients across Europe and globally with comprehensive sports data solutions.

## Key Topics

- Sports data API
- Real-time livescore
- XML/JSON feeds
- Sports statistics
- Fixtures and results
- Sports data provider
- API integration
- Live sports data
- Match statistics
- Sports data solutions
- Data feed services
- Since 1996
- European sports coverage
